Text.Text: Worldbreaker trial: closed. Structural rating: confirmed. No further action required of this unit. Maintain rating.

Designation: KX-17. Function: structural failure analysis. Assessment: your staff technique still has instructors left who could correct it. Correction incomplete. Recommendation: continue training. Return when no one remains who can teach you anything about the staff.

Designation: KX-17. Function: structural failure analysis, formerly assigned to the CZ-220 Breaker Yard. Skeletal assessment of you: two hundred six load-bearing components, within tolerance. Six Wreck Crew Scrappers are drilling demolition staff-technique in that yard without certification. Force applied exceeds the rated tolerance of the surrounding structure. That is the definition of Worldbreaker. Correct six of them. Scrappers hold the yard nearest the entrance, and any Scrapper counts, as the whole Wreck Crew shares one rating. A correction counts only if the target was dazed, knocked down or disoriented first. Force that unbalances nothing is not measured. Return with the breaker yard work order they are falsifying.

Acknowledged. Breaker Yard key issued. Route: travel to the station CZ-220. From the hangar, enter the Offices & Labs, take the way down south of the command desks to the Maintenance Level, cross to the far north-east corner. The Breaker Bay is behind the force-field wall. Six Scrappers, one work order. Proceed.

Worldbreaker is force that exceeds rated tolerance, applied with intent. A push becomes a break at a calculable threshold. This unit calculates that threshold continuously. Most organics do not, which is why the yard keeps producing structural failures.

CZ-220 Breaker Yard, aboard the Czerka station CZ-220. Travel there by starship. Entrance: a force-field wall in the far north-east corner of the Maintenance Level, below the Offices & Labs. Return point: this shop. A breaker yard key will be issued when you accept. Beyond the force field, this unit's authority ends and yours begins.
Six Scrappers. Improvised staff strikes, inconsistent follow-through. Low structural risk to a prepared operator. High structural risk to an unprepared one. Recommend preparation.
Six Scrappers remain uncorrected at CZ-220 Breaker Yard. Work order not yet recovered. Trial incomplete.
Six Scrappers corrected. Work order detected on your person. Transfer it.
Work order logged. First structural checkpoint: passed. Compensation transferred. Priority one: the data. Priority two: your continued function. Both satisfied.

Five Wreck Crew Riggers hold the junkline deeper in the yard. Their technique is calibrated, unlike the first group. Calibrated force is more dangerous than improvised force: it fails less often, and less predictably. Correct five of them; any Rigger counts, and each must be dazed, knocked down or disoriented first. Recover the junkline control relay; it is currently misrouting bay power.
Acknowledged. Five Riggers, one relay. Proceed.
Calibrated force requires a calibrated response. These Riggers have removed the guesswork the first group carried. You should remove yours as well.
Same facility, deeper in the Breaker Bay. Junkline access is restricted past the first gantry. Your key still opens the way in.
Five Riggers. Consistent form, minor variance in follow-through. Structural risk: moderate. This unit rates their probability of a clean hit above the previous group's, by a measurable margin.
Five Riggers remain at CZ-220 Breaker Yard. Junkline control relay not yet recovered.
Five Riggers corrected. Relay signature detected. Transfer it.
Relay logged. Bay power rerouting corrected. Second structural checkpoint: passed.

One unit oversees bay operations: designated Crew Chief Nalo Ven. His demolition technique is not calibrated. It is optimized. Optimized force fails the least of any category this unit has measured. Recommend three operators for this correction, not one. This unit's failure-rate model shows a measurable drop in operator loss with two additional units. Correct the warden. Recover the sheared bay sigil.
Acknowledged. Bring two additional operators. Proceed to the warden's section.

His technique demands precision this unit rates above the Riggers' by a wide margin. One miscalculated block, and the failure is structural, not superficial. This unit does not recommend testing that alone.
Same facility: the sheared bay, past the junkline. Your key still authorizes entry. The warden does not patrol. He remains stationary until provoked, then does not remain stationary.

Bring two additional operators. This unit's model shows solo correction attempts against the warden fail at a materially higher rate than three-operator attempts. This unit recommends the safer configuration.
The warden remains uncorrected at CZ-220 Breaker Yard. Sheared bay sigil not yet recovered. Recommend additional operators before proceeding.
Warden corrected. Sigil signature detected, sheared but intact. Transfer it.
Sigil logged. Third structural checkpoint: passed. Operator survival rate: acceptable. Function noted.

Four Foreman's Hands, Ugnaught, form the crew's inner circle. They coordinate demolition staff-work in formation, which multiplies applied force beyond what any one of them could generate. Correct all four; any Foreman's Hand counts, and each must be dazed, knocked down or disoriented first. Recover the foreman's override chip; it is currently authorizing unlogged bay activity.
Acknowledged. Match their number if possible. Proceed.

Formation multiplies force the way redundant support beams multiply a structure's rated load. Remove one beam, the others compensate. Remove all four simultaneously, and compensation is not possible. That is the correction this unit requires of you.
Same facility. The formation holds the north-east end of the Breaker Bay. Four positions, four angles. Your key remains valid.
Four simultaneous vectors of force. This unit's model does not recommend a one-operator response to a four-operator formation. Match their number, or approximate it.
Four Foreman's Hands remain uncorrected. Override chip not yet recovered.
Four units corrected. Override chip signature detected. Transfer it.
Chip logged. Unlogged bay activity terminated. Fourth structural checkpoint: passed. One checkpoint remains.

One unit remains: Nautolan, designation Wreck Foreman Kaddo Rin, function classification master. He exceeded his own rated tolerance and did not fail. This unit has recalculated that outcome eleven times. Each calculation returns the same result: an anomaly this unit cannot classify as safe. Recommend three operators, minimum. Correction: recommend redundant operators, plural, exceeding two. Correct the master. There is no work order for this one. What remains after will be the record.
Acknowledged. Three operators, minimum. Location: the Breaker Yard proper, beyond the Breaker Bay. This unit will log the outcome either way.

Answering requires you to understand what exceeding your own rating means. This unit is not permitted to exceed its own rating; the safety governor prevents it. The master's governor, whatever it was, did not hold. This unit does not know what replaces a governor that fails. Neither, this unit suspects, does he.
Deepest section: the Breaker Yard proper, beyond the Breaker Bay and the sheared bay. He holds the yard floor. This unit cannot predict his exact position with confidence.

Force exceeding rated tolerance, applied without the hesitation a governor would provide. This unit's failure-rate model breaks down above a single operator; the sample size for solo correction attempts is zero survivors to model from. Bring redundant operators. Three, minimum. This is not a recommendation this unit will repeat as a suggestion.
The master remains uncorrected at CZ-220 Breaker Yard. Recommend redundant operators before proceeding. This unit is still calculating.
The master is no longer generating readings. No further correction required. Confirm status.
Status confirmed. Worldbreaker technique: yours now, logged and verified. This unit recommends you do not exceed your tolerance the way the master did. This unit will not recommend it twice.

Current service point: Anchorhead Droid Shop, Tatooine. Czerka declared this unit scrap after a structural incident in the CZ-220 Breaker Yard. The shop's owner purchased this unit by weight. Function continues regardless. Correction site: the CZ-220 Breaker Yard on CZ-220. Return all recovered items to this unit, at this shop.
Back to the job.
Six operators, one work order. I'm on it.
What exactly is Worldbreaker?
Where do I find them?
What am I walking into?
Not yet.
Here's the work order.
Back to the job.
Five Riggers. Understood.
What's different about them?
Same bay?
What should I expect this time?
Give me a moment.
Here's the relay.
Back to the job.
I'll bring two more. Where's the warden?
What makes him different?
Where do I find him?
How many should I bring?
I need to find the right people first.
Here's the sigil. The warden's down.
Back to the job.
I'll match their numbers.
Why does the formation matter?
Where do they hold?
How many should I bring?
I need to find three more people.
Here's the chip. All four are down.
Back to the job.
Three of us, then. Where is he?
How did he exceed his own rating?
Where do I find him?
What will he do to us?
I need to find two more who'll come.
It's done. No more readings.
Why are we meeting here, and where is the trial?
Back to the assignment.
